Params = the only whole-SU proof with the die RF_RELAY: MR1 multirate d9507c056 (receipt results/arch/hbm_su_f2_static_1014/multirate_native_d9507c056: MULTIRATE=1, MLAT=4, ALAT=3, LEAF=1, RF_RELAY=36, RR10/WR7). DOUBT: the RTL default is still MULTIRATE=0/MLAT=3/LEAF=0 (su_multirate_top_contract.json default_parameter 0, candidate 1); MULTIRATE=1 is required by the v7 die clocking (slices serial 900 + pg_clk stream 1200). H-SU branch claude/hsu-k0r2-1705 (PIN_REG lane, programme 7116->7120) is NOT on main and not used. Command source: ot_hbm_su_programme (serial plane, 9688-bit line = 4 x {control1742,vmr240,vmw312,rf54,red74}, MSB->LSB, so quarter q red_cmd=[q*2422+0,+74), rf_rd=[+74,+128), vmw=[+128,+440), vmr=[+440,+680), control=[+680,+2422)); one central instance fans 9688 bits to all four quadrants -- it has NO die slot and its fixed S+4 timing assumes a direct registered boundary, so any die relay on that fan-out must be absorbed by the compiler epoch (H-SU/H-DIE). The stream programme plane (64-bit VM calendar cal_rd/cal_wr) belongs to the VM/calendar region, not here. Quarter glue: red_sel is pure wiring (bound as bit-slice edges); rf_drain_now (AND) and the relay head valid (red_sv&&red_tag[8], AND) have no die home -> gaps G-SU-DRAIN-NOW-*, G-SU-RFR-VALID-*. RF relays: 16 routes x 36 = 576 x hbfd_rly_48_<flow> (one register stage each, async active-low clear of ALL 48 bits from rs; the top's st_v reset is a subset, data reset is harmless); ck = clk_relay[w] = serial, rs = rst_n. PAD: stage 0 i[41:48] tied 0 (straps), last-stage o[41:48] open; logical width 41 = {v, addr8, data32} at bits 40, 39:32, 31:0. Flow per stage from su_rf_relays_v7 home deltas (next-home direction). SFU: RTL on main says the core IS ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine with LG_PATH=1+R (ot_hgi_sfu_split_engine is a composition with no own logic; leaves+relays are die instances; H-SU 72130e7c9, Qswiglu exact at R=0/R=9). R=11 per sfu_core_request_v7 (LG_PATH 12; the compiler's SFU_LG_PATH IO calendar must be regenerated for 12 -- only R=9 was benched). SFU relays use the DEDUPE standard hbfd_rly_624 (fwd 596 b = rq34+wq562, bwd 516 b = rr514+done2) x 11 stages x 2 directions x 16 pairs = 352; PAD fwd 28 b, bwd 108 b. SFU core has NO slot (PROPOSED strip; H-SM must shrink SM rows) and the relay stages have no homes -> placement open (H-DIE). SFU rst_lane_n/rst_map_n are given as stream resets (v15 listed them under the loader/CP owner; if a programme-controlled lane reset is intended they move into G-SFU-LOADER). Faults: pgslice/qcore/sfucore fault outputs unconsumed (no die status aggregator in this region). hb_argmax.am_stream gap is recorded here per H-SU ownership (instance is the coordinator's).
